conditions.reward: Realized delayed return and policy likelihood.
conditions.whole: Reward objective and realized-route whole-body early forecast loss.
conditions.sham: Same as whole, with the following independent row's realized return as the forecast target.
conditions.bridge: Same as whole, with auxiliary credit applied to both directions' base bridge weights and the bias and leak of primary neurons 12 and 13. Policy credit reaches the entire graph.
conditions.cut_out: Same as whole, with the primary-to-replica current bridge disabled from door cue to choice.
conditions.cut_back: Same as whole, with the replica-to-primary current bridge disabled from door cue to choice.

graph: One 40-node TrialGraph with two 20-node populations, the same architecture in every fit.
current_cuts: The specified current bridge is zero. Shared recurrence, draft and adoption still run.
forecast: Read primary neurons 12 and 13 two recurrent ticks before motor neurons 10 and 11 commit. Forecast loss is squared error at the selected door's own delayed ±1 payoff. The graph runs the final two ticks normally subject to the assigned current intervention.
feedback: Each training route physically commits just one door and receives that door's delayed taste.

exploration.record: Exact behavior right propensity and draw.

policy: Actual delayed return centered by a leave-one-route-out batch baseline, scored at the mixture likelihood.
